name: Bask In The Currents
description:
§r[warn]This multiblock always runs recipes at the same tier as the energy hatches in the structure. If the machine does not have enough power supplied, it won't turn on.[/warn]

Although this multiblock is available in IV, we recommend building one §nafter finishing the Naqline§r.


This multiblock has 3 different modes: §3Normal§r, §4EBF§r, and §6Ore§r.


In §3Normal§r mode, this multiblock §3processes normal arc furnace recipes§r.

In §4EBF§r mode, this multiblock can process §4every EBF recipe regardless of coil tier requirement§r. This feature comes at the cost of §lbase recipe voltage being increased by 2 tiers§r. The available recipes are limited to the energy hatch tier.

In §6Ore§r mode, this machine can only process ores and raw ores that can be smelted in a normal furnace, giving molten metal directly.


In addition to the modes, this machine has 3 different processing phases.

§lStartup:§r The machine ignites its arc for 6 seconds before it can process recipes. Startup power depends on the installed electrode's stats: §6maximum parallels§r * §2EU Modifier§r * (1 + §4Startup Penalty§r). The required amperage is shown as §lStartup Amperage§r in the electrode tooltip.

§lProcessing:§r During this phase, the machine processes recipes using the Speed, Parallels, OC, and EU Modifier statistics of the installed electrode. If the machine fails to find a recipe that it can use, it goes into the shutdown phase.

§lShutdown:§r The machine enters a 6-second phase during which it does not process any recipes and does not use any power. After the shutdown phase, it needs to go through startup again before processing recipes.


Electrodes also have durability and may provide unique special effects. Some electrodes can modify the normal Startup, Processing, or Shutdown behavior, so always check the electrode's tooltip.

Below §c25% remaining durability§r, every processing attempt has a §c5% chance§r to cause a random arc surge, forcing the machine to go through Startup again.
